    Viewer (read-only)

    Read-only link
    
      
    Anyone with this link can read the document. It is a copy in view
        mode: nothing they do reaches this file, and the link can be revoked from the library.
    
      
      
    The copy carries this release's assets by reference, so a reader
        fetches the same runtime every other document in the library uses.
